items.title: AI Filmmaking Platform Core Studio Launches at Taiwan Creative Content Fest With 24 Specialized Agents
items.excerpt: Taiwan's imCore launches Core Studio at TCCF, an AI filmmaking platform with 24 specialized agents covering script development through production, running its own image model plus outside generative models.
items.rationale: New product launch: an agent-based production platform that covers script through production, a concrete tool rather than more panel talk.

items.title: 생성형 AI가 제작한 애니 '두근두근 멜로츄!'…첫 영상 공개
items.excerpt: 크리에이티브 스튜디오 뜨거운바다가 생성형 AI로 제작한 오리지널 애니메이션 '두근두근 멜로츄!' 첫 편(뉴욕 배경, 약 5분)을 공개했다.
items.rationale: New release: a Korean studio's original animated series made with generative AI has published its first episode, so there is finished work to judge.

items.title: The Future of Video Production is Here!
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge tutorial on a realistic AI-clone workflow: record audio and a reference video to produce on-camera footage without a studio.
items.rationale: Replacement for the dropped Resolve 21.2 card: a hands-on AI-clone workflow for producing on-camera footage from an audio track and a reference video. Enrichment should confirm the video is not a sponsored vendor pitch and swap it out if it is.

items.title: How to Remove Music from Your AI Videos (Easy Tutorial)
items.excerpt: Tutorial on stripping music out of AI-generated or regular clips with Meta's free SAM Audio sound-isolation tool to get clean effects tracks.
items.rationale: Hands-on workflow: a free AI sound-isolation tool removes baked-in music from generated clips, a common post-production problem.

items.title: Camera improvements: Will AI mods fix Framerate Malpractice before the guilty manufacturers bother to do it themselves?
items.excerpt: Users are now using AI to write firmware mods that add missing features to cameras - could AI-made mods fix missing frame rates before manufacturers do?
items.rationale: Fresh angle on production gear: shooters are using AI coding tools to write camera firmware mods that unlock frame rates the manufacturers left out.
